area_note: Island-wide: the CBD and Marina Bay, the Singapore Sports Hub at Kallang, East Coast Park, and heartland stadiums from Jurong to Punggol
intro: Most Singapore group runs happen on weekday evenings from about 6.30pm to 7.45pm, after office hours, or early on weekend mornings between about 6am and 7.30am. Common meeting points are Raffles Place and Marina Bay in the CBD, the 100PLUS Promenade and The Kallang at the Singapore Sports Hub, Parkland Green in East Coast Park, Jurong Lake Gardens, and public stadium tracks such as Bishan, Bukit Gombak and MOE (Evans Road) for interval work. Most community clubs and brand clubs are free to join, and several hash groups run social trails on weekday evenings.

clubs.name: Running Department

meets.where: UOB Plaza, Raffles Place (some weeks at The Kallang, Great Eastern Promenade)
Parkland Green, East Coast Park

clubs.who: All levels; Saturday pop-up runs are women-only
clubs.description: A volunteer-run community founded in 2013 that holds free, no-frills weekly runs (base, tempo, strength and hill sessions over 5 km or 10 km) and publishes its schedule at the start of each month. Runners register once through its Dept. Access platform; most runs need no sign-up.
clubs.active_evidence: Monthly schedule for September 2026 and a news post dated 8 Sep 2026 on its website

clubs.name: Lion City Road Runners (LCRR)

meets.where: Rotates: Water Sports Centre, The Kallang; Punggol Promenade Nature Walk; PAssion Wave @ Marina Bay

clubs.cost: Free (registration required, opens each Monday or Tuesday)
clubs.who: Runners entered in the BYD Singapore International Marathon or adidas Half Marathon; 16+ for runs up to 21 km, 18+ for longer runs
clubs.description: A free structured training programme for runners entered in the BYD Singapore International Marathon or the adidas Half Marathon, powered by Running Department, running until the end of November. Sessions are run in loops of about 6 km, with nine pace groups from 4:59 to 7:49 min/km, and include bag drop and hydration. You do not need to belong to a club to join.
clubs.active_evidence: Sessions listed for 3-31 Oct 2026 on the race's official site; details confirmed by the race organiser by email, 1 Oct 2026

Bukit Gombak Stadium

The schedule above is from Shopee's March 2026 round-up, and the marathon's 2026 listing shows runs on Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays.

clubs.name: Singapore Falcons RC
clubs.cost: Guests run free with a member; membership is S$30 a year
clubs.who: All abilities; membership is capped at 300 active members, with a wait list
clubs.description: A non-profit amateur club affiliated with Singapore Athletics, covering road, track, trail, ultra and triathlon. It publishes a free 12-week adaptable training plan, and newcomers are asked to try a Tuesday track session before applying to join.

clubs.name: Singapore Shufflers

meets.where: Home of Athletics
MOE Evans Road Track or Bishan Stadium
Bukit Brown

clubs.who: Committed intermediate to advanced runners looking for structured, performance-based training. Spaces are limited, so email the club about joining first
clubs.description: A performance road-running club whose sessions are led by World Athletics certified coaches. Runners are split into ability-based groups and follow periodised programmes aimed at major races and key periods of the year. The club says it is the top-ranked road running club in Singapore, with age-category wins and podium places in Berlin, Valencia, Gold Coast, Wuxi, Melbourne, Seoul and more.
clubs.active_evidence: 2026 club 5K handicap result and a privacy policy updated 15 Aug 2026 on its website; schedule and description confirmed by the club by email, 2 Oct 2026
